{{Youmayd|the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer|"Vendetta"|[[Vendetta]]}}
The '''''Vendetta''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ander Rendrake/Legends|Ander Rendrake]], who was secretly a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], served aboard the ''Vendetta''. During his time aboard the ''Vendetta'', Rendrake managed to acquire a number of [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]] and access codes, allowing him access to every part of the Star Destroyer.
